<ModelBehaviors> <Include ModelBehaviorFile="ASOBO\Inputs\Helpers.xml"/> <!-- Generic light template USAGE FOR A 3 POS SWITCH : - When using TYPE:=TwoIndices, you must define SIMVAR_INDEX and SIMVAR_INDEX_2 - When using TYPE:=TwoSimvars, you must define LIGHT_TYPE and LIGHT_TYPE_2 In both cases, it is strongly recommanded to define the following states (with either 0 1 2 or -1 for an 'impossible to reach' state, since there are 4 states for a 3 pos switch) : - STATE_1ST_ID : toggle ON only the first simvar/indice (OFF the second) - STATE_2ND_ID : toggle ON only the second simvar/index (OFF the first) - STATE_ON_ID : toggle ON both - STATE_OFF_ID : toggle OFF both DEFAULT_INDICE_ON_CONFLICT : When the two simvars/indices are in a state the switch can't reach (-1), chose that position and force the corresponding sim behavior --> <Template Name="ASOBO_LIGHTING_Light_Template"> <Parameters Type="Default"> <Condition Check="LIGHT_TYPE" Match="POTENTIOMETER"> <True>
